meta.author: Your School Benchmate & Crime Partner Forever
meta.subject: Why You Are My Sister For Life

paragraphs: I know we spent our entire school life pulling each other's legs, fighting over pens, stealing lunchboxes, and pretending we were too cool to ever say anything sentimental. But today, I am taking off the jokes, the sarcasm, and the teasing to tell you something straight from the most honest part of my heart.

Most great friendships in movies are born from weekend road trips, late-night cafe hangouts, or party adventures. We never had that. We never spent time together outside school gates. When the 2:00 PM dismissal bell rang, we went to our separate homes and lived separate lives.
And yet, in those six short hours between the morning assembly and the dismissal bell, you gave me something I never expected to find in a classroom: A real sister. A confidante. A sanctuary.

You have no idea how much I genuinely loved talking to you. Whenever school felt dull, stressful, or overwhelming, one glance at your ridiculous expressions or one shared whisper across the desks was enough to turn my entire day around. Your laughter carries this rare, effortless magic that makes people feel alive and safe.

Look at that video call photo with the forehead dots and cheek scribbles—anyone else might have hidden it or felt embarrassed, but you wore it with pride and smiled. That is who you are: completely authentic, fiercely confident, and wonderfully unapologetic.

School days are behind us, and life will take us down different roads. But I want you to remember this forever: you are brilliant, you are hilarious, your heart is purer than gold, and you deserve every single ounce of happiness, success, and love in this world.

Even if our entire story unfolded within school walls, in my life you will always hold the permanent place of my real sister. Wherever you go, you will always have a brother cheering for your triumphs, scolding you when you act like a 'pgli gawar', and standing right by your side.
letter.signoff: Forever your proud school benchmate, protector, and brother,
